clips.send: National Supervisory Commission. Supervisory commissions are the state’s supervisory organs; the National Supervisory Commission is the highest one. Added to the Constitution by the 2018 amendment. It supervises all public employees who exercise public power. Three duties: supervise, investigate, and deal with (监督, 调查, 处置) duty-related violations and crimes such as bribery. It uses its power independently according to law, free from interference by administrative organs, organisations or individuals.

clips.send: The President. The President of the People’s Republic of China is an important part of the state organs and represents the country at home and abroad. Elected by the NPC. Acting on decisions of the NPC and its Standing Committee: promulgates laws, appoints and removes the Premier and ministers, awards state medals and honours, issues special pardons, proclaims a state of emergency or of war. Represents China in state affairs: receives foreign ambassadors and makes state visits.

clips.send: Supreme People’s Procuratorate. People’s procuratorates are the state’s organs of legal supervision; the Supreme People’s Procuratorate is the highest. A procuratorate is roughly China’s public prosecutor’s office — with extra supervising duties. It approves arrests and brings criminal cases to court on behalf of the state (public prosecution). It checks that investigations, trials and the carrying out of sentences follow the law. It can bring public-interest lawsuits, for example over pollution or unsafe food. A higher procuratorate leads the lower ones.

clips.send: Created by, answers to, supervised by. The administrative, supervisory, trial and procuratorial organs are all created by the people’s congress, answer to it and are supervised by it. Created by: the NPC elects or decides on the leaders of each organ. Answers to: each organ reports on its work to the NPC. Supervised by: the NPC can question the organs and remove their leaders. Each organ still does its own job — a division of work, described as “democratic centralism”.

clips.send: State Council. The State Council, that is, the Central People’s Government, is the executive body of the highest organ of state power and the highest administrative organ. Led by the Premier (总理), under the “Premier responsibility system”. Runs the country’s administration: the economy, education, science, health, the environment and more. Makes administrative regulations in line with the Constitution and the laws. Local people’s governments are the local administrative organs; all of them are under the State Council’s unified leadership. Governments must act according to law (依法行政).

clips.send: Local levels — and the armed forces. The same pattern repeats at each level: province, city, county, township. Each level has a people’s congress and a people’s government. From county level up there are also a supervisory commission, a court and a procuratorate. Each local organ is created by the congress at its own level, answers to it and is supervised by it. The Constitution also sets up the Central Military Commission (中央军事委员会), which leads the country’s armed forces.

clips.send: Supreme People’s Court. People’s courts are the state’s trial organs; the Supreme People’s Court is the highest. Courts hear criminal, civil and administrative cases and settle disputes by judging them. Their rule: “take facts as the basis and the law as the yardstick”. They exercise trial power independently according to law. A higher court supervises the trial work of lower courts.

clips.send: National People’s Congress. The National People’s Congress (NPC) is the highest organ of state power. Legislative power: amends the Constitution; makes and amends basic laws. Power to decide: approves national plans and budgets and other major matters. Power to appoint and remove: elects or decides on the top leaders of the other state organs — and can remove them. Power to supervise: watches over the Constitution and the work of the other organs. Its Standing Committee (常务委员会) is its permanent body and works when the NPC is not in session. Local people’s congresses are the local organs of state power.

clips.send: 最高人民法院。人民法院是国家的审判机关；最高人民法院是最高审判机关。人民法院通过审理刑事、民事、行政等案件，惩罚犯罪，解决纠纷，维护社会公平正义。坚持以事实为根据，以法律为准绳。依照法律规定独立行使审判权，不受行政机关、社会团体和个人的干涉。最高人民法院监督地方各级人民法院和专门人民法院的审判工作；上级人民法院监督下级人民法院的审判工作。
